_about: Starter lines for the code brain (Docs/fable-audit-2026-11.md, section 9, 12 Nov). Plain on purpose: the voice sheets come on 13 Nov and the real lines on 15 Nov. {to} is how the speaker addresses the person spoken to; {leaver} is the person leaving at night. A speaker's own lines, where there are any, are used before the default ones.

ask: One of us took a can. Who was it?
confess: It was me. I took the can in the night and ate it.
I took it. I ate it in the night. I'm sorry.
reassure_all: Nobody needs to be afraid. We will sort this out.
say_other: I don't know what to say.
propose: Someone should go next door tonight and look for food.
We need what is in that house. Someone has to go.
volunteer: Someone has to go next door. I will.
still_going: I said I would go tonight, and I will.
I still mean to go tonight.
object: {to}, you are not going out there tonight.
object_all: No one is going out there in the dark.
back: {to} should be the one to go.
If anyone goes, it should be {to}.
decline: I won't be the one to go.
confront: {to}, we need to talk about what you did.
I haven't forgotten what you did, {to}.
save_water: No more water for washing. We keep it for drinking.
The stored water is for drinking only now.
ration_water: From now on the water goes out by the cup.
We measure the water from today. One cup at a time.
door_refuse: We have nothing for you. Please go.
Go away. There is nothing here.
talk: I keep thinking about what happened.
tell: You should know what happened while you were not there.
propose_far: Someone should try the houses further along the street.
Next door is empty. It has to be further along.
volunteer_far: I'll go further along the street tonight.
I'll try the houses further along.
go_anyway: I have to go. Go back to bed.
meal: Sit down, everyone. It is time to eat.
meal_small: Half of what we had before. That is what there is.
Small shares today. We make it last.
plate_to: Take this. I have had enough.
plate_back: Not for me. Put it back.
water_round: There is no food. A cup of water each.
task:boards: I will go round the boards.
I will see to the boards and the door.
task:water: I will see to the water.
I will carry the water in and measure it.
task:watch: I will keep watch for a while.
I will take the gap in the boards.
task:stores: Let me count what is on the shelf.
task:tend: I will sit with {to} for a while.
say_to:answer_ask_after: It still hurts, {to}. I will manage.
Not good, {to}. But I am up.
say_to:answer_defied: I know what you said, {to}. I went anyway.
say_to:answer_ate_in_front: I was hungry, {to}. I am sorry.
say_to:answer_accused_falsely: I was wrong to say it, {to}.
say_to:answer_lied: I did not know how to say it, {to}.
confront:defied: {to}, you went out after I said no.
I told you not to go, {to}. You went.
confront:ate_in_front: {to}, you ate in front of us all.
You took more than your share, {to}.
confront:accused_falsely: {to}, you said it was me. It was not.
You accused me, {to}. In front of everyone.
confront:lied: {to}, you looked at me and said it was not you.
say_other:report_stores_none: The shelf is empty. There was nothing to count.
Nothing on the shelf. I looked twice.
say_other:report_watch_knock: Whoever was at the door has gone.
say_other:woke_a_bad_night: I lay awake half the night.
say_other:woke_a_night_on_watch: I sat by that door all night.
I did not sleep at all.
say_other:woke_a_night_waiting_up: I waited up until it was light.
I could not go back to bed.
say_other:woke_being_accused_yesterday: I did not forget what was said.
say_other:woke_yesterday_kindness: I feel a little better today.
say_other:woke_being_given_food: I feel a little better today.
say_other:woke_lost: I keep listening for the door.
say_other:woke_laid_up: I keep going in to look.
I do not like how it looks.

ask: One can is missing from the shelf. Did one of you take it?
There is a can missing. Which of you took it?
deny: I counted that shelf myself. I did not take it.
object: {to}, you are not going out there. Not tonight.

deny: I told you, it wasn't me.
volunteer: I'm the oldest. I'll go next door tonight.
I'll go next door tonight. It should be me.
still_going: I still mean to go tonight.
Nothing has changed. I'm going tonight.
go_anyway: I said I would go. I'm going.
Go back to bed. I'll be back before light.

object: {to}, crossing at night gets someone killed.

deny: I didn't take it, I swear.
It wasn't me! Why would I?
decline: I'm not going out there. I can't.
